quiz_map.support: The fifth comes from the platform's audit log.
The span with no parent is the root span.

Capture is controlled by a setting whose environment variable is `OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_CONTENT`, with the values `NO_CONTENT` (the default), `SPAN_ONLY`, `EVENT_ONLY` and `SPAN_AND_EVENT`.
To record `InvokeAgent` you configure advanced event selectors for the resource type `AWS::Bedrock::AgentAlias`.
This decides where to look for proof that the action happened: the Lambda's logs in the first case, the application's own logs and spans in the second.
The session name is the part after the last slash of the `arn`.
If a change record covers it and the configuration change came from the deployment identity, the verdict is benign true positive, not false positive.
The application's trace store has nothing for those minutes, because the caller was not the application.
The span with no parent is the root span.
To rebuild a run, filter on one trace_id, find the root, attach every other span to the span whose span_id equals its parent_id, and sort spans that share a parent by start_time.
The capture setting defaults to NO_CONTENT, and the attribute gen_ai.tool.call.arguments is Opt-In.
Span status Unset is the default, and it means the operation completed without an error.
A normal rebooking is therefore a root span with five children in this order: invoke_agent, execute_tool search_flights, invoke_agent, execute_tool rebook_ticket, invoke_agent.
Data events are data plane operations, such as InvokeAgent, and CloudTrail does not log data events by default.
The session name is the part after the last slash of userIdentity.arn.
A change to DRAFT does not change production until an alias is pointed at a new version, which is done with UpdateAgentAlias.
The field eventCategory holds Management or Data, so one field tells you whether a record is a change to the agent or a run of it.
A benign true positive means the rule caught exactly the behaviour it targets, and the activity was authorised: for the new-tool rule, a tool added by an approved release.
If CloudTrail shows InvokeAgent calls for which the trace store has no spans, the caller was not the application.
A loop that deserves an alert looks different: the same tool succeeds again and again in one trace.
UpdateAgentAlias with aliasInvocationState set to REJECT_INVOCATIONS pauses the agent, and ACCEPT_INVOCATIONS starts it again.

new_vendor.label: OpenTelemetry GenAI spans
new_vendor.note: A span rendered as a flat record. Envelope keys name, context.trace_id, context.span_id, parent_id, start_time, end_time and the attributes object follow the illustrative span JSON at opentelemetry.io/docs/concepts/signals/traces/ (which states it is not a specific export format; OTLP/JSON is more verbose). kind and status are flat renderings of the documented span kind and span status properties. attributes.gen_ai.* are the GenAI semantic convention attributes (status Development) from github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai, docs/gen-ai (gen-ai-agent-spans.md, execute-tool.md, client-invoke-agent.md, client-inference.md); error.type and server.address are the stable attributes those conventions reference. Checked 2026-11-26.
